access_note: Public metadata and licence opened without sign-in. UKCEH terms must be accepted for data access; scripted bulk access may require a personal token. No file download or licence acceptance was attempted.
description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes this monthly MaRIUS-G2G output for British hydrological and drought studies. Grid-to-Grid simulations driven by CEH-GEAR rainfall and MORECS potential evaporation give mean river flow and soil moisture on a 1 km grid from 1960 to 2015. EIDC describes NetCDF output and accompanying gridded catchment areas and gauge-location material. Its own DOI page exposes a file-access route. The UKCEH click-through licence allows royalty-free personal or internal business use but restricts redistribution and financially beneficial derived products. A modeller can compare spatial drought evolution, set antecedent soil-water states or test runoff scenarios. The soil moisture and flow are model estimates, not field measurements; their 1 km cells should not be treated as gauge precision. The catalogue UK Environment Agency flood-monitoring API is a related observation source, not this gridded model output.
name: Grid-to-Grid model estimates of monthly mean flow and soil moisture for Great Britain (1960 to 2015): observed driving data [MaRIUS-G2G-MORECS-monthly]
